admin_management_specification.location: /admin with Onboarding tab or OnboardingManager component
features: CRUD operations: Create new steps, edit existing title/description/type/milestone, delete steps
Reorder controls: Drag or move up/down step sequence order
Enable / Disable toggle: Switch step status active/inactive
Duplicate step: One-click clone step configuration
Live Step Preview Modal: Interactive preview of any step in cream+jade+gold mobile frame
Preset step templates: Welcome, Avatar Picker, Profile Form, Static Showcase, Ready Banner

instructions_to_main_agent.visual_theme_enforcement: Use Cream (#FAF8F5) as outer/mobile container background, Deep Jade (#0B2B28) as primary card body, Gold (#D4AF37) for buttons, badges, subtle glowing borders, and progress highlights.
instructions_to_main_agent.static_screens_rule: Steps 4-8 are educational feature showcases (Offers, Quests, Watch & Earn, Offerwall, Refer & Earn). They MUST NOT call live earning APIs during onboarding.
instructions_to_main_agent.persistence: On completion of Step 9 or clicking Finish, persist onboarding status in user settings/supabase/localStorage and navigate smoothly to /home.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_onboarding_manager: Ensure OnboardingManager.tsx provides full CRUD, drag/button reorder, enable/disable toggle, duplicate, and live step preview modal with rich Cream+Jade+Gold styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_requirement: Every step button, avatar card, form input, step switcher, and admin control MUST have an explicit data-testid attribute for reliable automated E2E testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No generic AI slop: Use layered z-index hierarchy, gold glow effects, and polished typography.
Responsive mobile-app look: Embed onboarding within a sleek mobile frame container on desktop or full mobile view.
Accessibility: APCA / WCAG compliant text contrast against Jade and Gold surfaces.
All interactive components MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
